title: A new internal work order gets no automatic fees or default discount
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the organization has an auto-apply fee template of $10.00 on new work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with a default discount of 5% and one asset, asset 1.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Click Save in the New Work Order window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Internal" badge shows.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • The work order opens with no $10.00 fee and no 5% discount.
  • Its menu offers no "Add Work Order Fee / Discount".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R21: “At creation of an internal or no-charge work order, auto-apply fee and discount templates and the customer's default discount are not applied at all; S2-R15 (removal) applies to a work order converted later. On a billable work order with no-charge lines, work order fees and discounts stay and are computed on the billable amounts; only the marked line's own discount is removed (S12-R4).”
  • S2-R15: “When a work order becomes internal or no charge, its work order fees and discounts and its line discounts are removed with the prices, and "Add Work Order Fee / Discount" is not shown in its menu. Making it billable again prices the lines from the customer's pricing and does not restore removed fees or discounts.”
